security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: An AI-triaged to-do list for your email
bundle.longDescription: Inbox Agent watches your mailbox, ranks every message by how much it needs you, and turns it into one focused to-do list with alerts. Your mail is read on your computer and your password stays in the system keychain.
